back: A personal letter or email to a friend or relative written in a friendly, conversational register.
Short opening → one developed paragraph per bullet point → friendly close looking forward to a reply.
Dear/Hi/Hello + first name; Love, Best wishes, Take care, Your friend + first name.
Contractions, direct questions, exclamations, personal feelings, friendly phrases; still correct grammar and spelling.
Between 120 and 160 words (about 140); three bullet prompts to cover.
Why don't you…? How about…? If I were you, I'd… You should definitely…

front: Why content marks are lost in informal letters
back: A bullet point is missed or only mentioned in passing instead of developed.
Never use u, gr8, lol and similar forms: they lose language marks.
